about: Guided task journeys compose existing knowledge articles and offering actions. Step text is a routing summary of the linked source article and must not introduce new procedures, eligibility, contacts or status. Every step must cite an existing article id

steps.title: Active
steps.detail: Accounts are normally active while you are enrolled in courses

steps.title: Expiring
steps.detail: When you are no longer an active student your accounts enter an expiry process and you are notified by email

steps.title: Cancelled
steps.detail: Accounts still exist but you cannot sign in to them

steps.title: Removed
steps.detail: Accounts and associated data are deleted and cannot be recovered

steps.title: How employee accounts are created and retired
